words.word: for as a prince hast thou power

occurrences.text: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
words: for as a prince hast thou power

occurrences.text: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:
